opportunities.title: Oracle Patched Everything. They Got Breached Anyway — Inside CISA's 3-Day 'Perfect 10' Scramble

opportunities.angle: Explainer + timeline mashup: what the CVE is, why 3-day patching exists, and why patching alone isn't enough — classic 'inevitable breach' framing
